jobs.title: Junior Software Engineer (Python) - Montreal - Up to $130,000 CAD + Exceptional Bonuses/Benefits
jobs.description:
Title:
Junior Software Engineer (Python)
Client:
Elite Quant Start-Up
$$$:
Up to $130,000 CAD + Bonuses + Exceptional Benefits Package
Location:
Montreal (Hybrid)

The Opportunity:

Join a front-office engineering team building the systems traders and quants depend on every second. You’ll build high-performance Python tools at the heart of real-time risk, pricing, and decision-making, working directly with the people putting them to work.

What You'll Do:

Build fast, scalable Python
systems that sit at the core of real-time risk and pricing
Work directly with quants and traders to turn complex risk ideas into production-grade tools
Help define the architecture of a unified, next-gen front-office risk platform

Who You Are:

Strong Computer Science fundamentals (degree preferred, not essential)
Exceptional Python skills with 2+ years of relevant experience
Curious, analytical, and genuinely interested in markets, trading, and how things work under the hood
Enjoy solving hard technical and mathematical problems where performance matters
A strong teammate with personality - you care about building great systems and building great relationships

Sound like your next opportunity?

Apply now or reach out directly: 📩 hhandelman@hunterbond.com
